rubric: A vague slowdown reported as a question: a bug report and a question are both fair readings, so the confidence must stay in the middle.

reading.why: two readings are fair; see readings

criteria.kind: something does not work as it should, and it is not an emergency

readings.why: A dashboard that is slower than last week is something that does not work as it should, and it is not an emergency.

criteria.kind: someone asks how something works or what to do
